lines.text: Brandlhuber is closed. They wanted 9.5% more, and we settled at 6.5%. That's about €53,000 under their opening, and about €75,000 under our alternative supplier. Want to know where we could have done better?
Where did we leave money on the table?
In the pace, not in the arguments. In round 3 the foundry moved about €4,200. We moved €16,200, almost four times as much.
Then in round 4 we pulled back €13,500. The owner called it a significant step backwards, and sent his final offer one round later.

No. In their last 6 renewals they always settled below what they asked, between −5.6% and −0.1%. This time they got +6.5%. They are short of cash, and we did offer faster payment, so the lever was right. The pacing was not.
Never out-concede the supplier. In the concession planner, I would cap our step at 0.8× their last step, down from 1.1×. I've sent it to Agent Studio for your approval.

params.title: Never out-concede the supplier
params.rationale: P01 round 3: the foundry moved €4,235, we moved €16,190 (3.8×). In round 4 we pulled back €13,496; the owner called it "a significant step backwards" and sent a final offer one round later.
params.quote: Your latest proposal for 30-day payment terms represents a significant step backwards from your previous offer.
